summary: First iteration full-stack testing for Admin Control MVP (3-partner Mexican company app). 12/12 backend pytest tests passed covering auth, partners, projects CRUD + P&L, transactions CRUD + 4 filters, dividends, dashboard math, and 33.33% partner portal math (including paid_personally and dividends_withdrawn). End-to-end UI flow passed: login (valid+invalid), dashboard, project creation, income/expense creation with paid_personally, partner+URL project filters, dividend withdrawal, and 33.33% math reflected correctly in UI ($1200 net -> $400 share, Carlos: $400+$300 personal-$100 retiro = $600 available).

minor.issue: set_cookie uses secure=False and samesite='lax'; works for current preview but in HTTPS production should be secure=True and samesite='none' for cross-site cookie usage. Bearer flow via localStorage is the primary auth path so this is non-blocking.
CORS_ORIGINS='*' with allow_credentials=True is invalid per spec; browsers ignore credentials when origin is wildcard. Should set explicit origin in prod.
share_pct hardcoded to 1/3; not configurable per partner. Acceptable for MVP given 3 equal partners requirement.

issues: Two 401 console errors on /login (likely /auth/me probe before login). Not user-visible but should be silenced with a try/catch or guard.

action_items: (Minor) Suppress 401 console noise on /login by skipping /auth/me when there is no token in localStorage.
(Minor, for prod) Replace CORS_ORIGINS='*' with explicit frontend origin and set cookie secure=True, samesite='none' for HTTPS deployments.
(Nice-to-have) Confirm whether dividends should be tagged by payment_method (cash/transfer) and decrement cash_balance/transfer_balance; currently dashboard cash/transfer balances ignore dividends.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is a single 428-line file mixing models, routes, seed logic and middleware. Consider splitting into routers/models/db modules before adding more features.
No PUT endpoint exposed for dividends (only POST/GET/DELETE) – fine if intentional, but should be documented.
validations: amount is float with no >0 check; could allow negative amounts. Add Pydantic conlist/PositiveFloat.
Dashboard cash_balance/transfer_balance do not subtract dividend withdrawals. If dividends are paid out of company cash/transfer, this leaves a stale balance. Confirm business intent.
PartnerPortal.jsx dividend modal uses default partner; ensure partner cannot withdraw more than available_to_collect (no client-side or server-side guard observed).

JWT secret is in .env (good) and JWT type='access' but no refresh flow; 12h hard expiry will silently log users out – consider adding 401-driven redirect to /login (already handled by interceptor most likely).

All forms have data-testid prefixes (login-*, project-*, tx-*, dividend-*, filter-*, partner-card-*, withdraw-*). Auth: localStorage 'access_token' + httpOnly cookie. Demo seed always present.
rca_of_the_issue: n/a - first iteration, no bugs to root-cause. All requested feature endpoints and UI flows behave correctly per spec.
